modals.installBodyWithPort: This will download and start <bold>{{name}}</bold> on port <bold>{{port}}</bold>.
modals.stopBody: The container will be stopped. Your data is preserved.
modals.restartBody: The container will be briefly stopped and restarted.
modals.reinstallWarning: This will delete all app data and cannot be undone.
modals.reinstallBody: The container and its associated volumes will be removed, then a fresh installation will begin.
modals.deleteWarning: This will permanently remove this custom app.
modals.deleteBody: The container will be stopped and removed. Host volume data will remain on disk.
modals.removeImage: Also remove the Docker image to reclaim disk space
modals.uninstallWarning: This will remove the app from this device.
modals.uninstallBody: The container will be stopped and removed, and the app returns to the catalog below. App data under the storage folder stays on disk, so reinstalling brings it back as it was.

card.modifiedTooltip: You've customized this app, so it won't be overwritten by catalog updates.
card.legacyTooltip: This is a legacy version that's no longer maintained. Install the current Education Platform from the catalog, then uninstall this one.

appsSettings.title: Apps
appsSettings.intro: Manage the applications that are available in your Project NOMAD instance. Nightly update checks will automatically detect when new versions of these apps are available.
appsSettings.installBody: Are you sure you want to install {{name}}? This will start the service and make it available in your Project NOMAD instance. It may take some time to complete.
appsSettings.forceReinstallBody: Are you sure you want to force reinstall {{name}}? This will <bold>WIPE ALL DATA</bold> for this service and cannot be undone. You should only do this if the service is malfunctioning and other troubleshooting steps have failed.
appsSettings.startConfirm: Are you sure you want to start {{name}}?
appsSettings.stopConfirm: Are you sure you want to stop {{name}}?
appsSettings.restartConfirm: Are you sure you want to restart {{name}}?

errors.internalInstall: An internal error occurred while trying to install the service.
errors.internalAffect: An internal error occurred while trying to affect the service.
errors.internalReinstall: An internal error occurred while trying to force reinstall the service.

errors.resolveBlocked: Resolve the blocked issues before installing.

customAppModal.categoryHelp: Select the most relevant category for this app. This helps with visual organization and filtering.
customAppModal.iconHelp: Pick an icon shown on the app card.
customAppModal.noPorts: No port mappings — the app won't be accessible from a browser.
customAppModal.portHint: Host ports should be in the 8600+ range. Custom apps get ports starting at {{port}}.
customAppModal.noVolumes: No volumes — data won't persist across restarts.
customAppModal.limitsHint: Caps prevent a runaway container from starving the host. Leave blank to use the defaults (1024 MB / 1 CPU).
customAppModal.restartPolicy: Containers are created with --restart=unless-stopped. Data is not persisted unless you add volume mounts above.

linkTileModal.addFailed: Failed to add this link. A link with that name may already exist.
linkTileModal.intro: Add a shortcut to something you already run, on this machine or anywhere else on your network. NOMAD does not manage it, it just puts a button on your dashboard.
linkTileModal.name: Name
linkTileModal.invalidUrl: Enter a valid URL, for example 192.168.1.50:8080 or https://nas.local.
linkTileModal.colorHint: Links stay outlined rather than filled whichever color you pick, so they are distinguishable from apps NOMAD manages.

appUrlModal.title: Set Custom URL
appUrlModal.intro: Set where <app>{{name}}</app> opens from — useful if you reach it through a reverse proxy or local DNS. Leave this empty to use the default address ({{address}}).
appUrlModal.label: Custom URL
appUrlModal.invalid: Enter a valid http(s) address (e.g. https://jellyfin.myhomelab.net). A bare host like "jellyfin.lan" becomes http://jellyfin.lan.

updateServiceModal.title: Update Service
updateServiceModal.question: Update {{name}} from {{current}} to {{target}}?
updateServiceModal.preserved: Your data and configuration will be preserved during the update.
updateServiceModal.majorWarning: It's not recommended to upgrade to a new major version (e.g. 1.8.2 → 2.0.0) unless you have verified compatibility with your current configuration. Always review the release notes and test in a staging environment if possible.

serviceStatsModal.title: Stats — {{name}}
serviceStatsModal.notRunning: This app is not running. Start it to see live resource usage.

serviceLogsModal.title: Logs — {{name}}
serviceLogsModal.loadFailed: Unable to load logs for this container.

downloadUrlModal.intro: Enter the URL of the map region file you wish to download. The URL must be publicly reachable and end with .pmtiles. A preflight check will be run to verify the file's availability, type, and approximate size.
downloadUrlModal.unknownError: An unknown error occurred during the preflight check.
downloadUrlModal.passed: Preflight check passed. Filename: {{filename}}, Size: {{size}} MB

gpuAlert.title: GPU Not Accessible to {{name}}
gpuAlert.noAccessAmd: Your system has an AMD GPU, but {{name}} can't access it. AI is running on CPU only, which is significantly slower.
gpuAlert.noAccessNvidia: Your system has an NVIDIA GPU, but {{name}} can't access it. AI is running on CPU only, which is significantly slower.
gpuAlert.needsOverride: Your system has an AMD GPU, but {{name}} is running on CPU only. Reinstalling won't fix this: the GPU isn't on ROCm's supported list and needs a GFX version override.
gpuAlert.needsOverrideWithTarget: Your system has an AMD GPU, but {{name}} is running on CPU only. Reinstalling won't fix this: the GPU ({{target}}) isn't on ROCm's supported list and needs a GFX version override.
gpuAlert.reinstalling: {{name}} is being reinstalled with GPU support. This page will reload shortly.
gpuAlert.reinstallBody: This will recreate the {{name}} container with GPU support enabled. Your downloaded models will be preserved. The service will be briefly unavailable during reinstall.
gpuAlert.saveOverrideFailed: Failed to save the GFX override: {{message}}
gpuAlert.rocmIntro: ROCm ships GPU kernels for a fixed list of AMD chips. Integrated Radeon GPUs outside that list run on CPU unless ROCm treats them as a supported chip, set through HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION.
gpuAlert.rdna2: Radeon 680M / 660M and other RDNA 2 iGPUs (gfx1031 to gfx1036): 10.3.0
gpuAlert.overrideHelp: Saving recreates the {{name}} container with this override. Downloaded models are preserved.
